verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability API ingests live production calls, sent by the agent or its provider's post-call webhook, stores each as a CallLog and automatically schedules metric evaluation on it. Sampling lets teams evaluate a percentage of incoming calls, and the vendor advertises live drift detection across every call, plus native observability integrations for Retell and LiveKit. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of production evaluation, and deeper documentation of real-time vs. post-call latency and alerting on live-traffic evaluator results.
